findings.description: The truthiness checks skip color index 0 for both foreground and background.
findings.rationale: When a caller passes fg=0 or bg=0, a valid ANSI palette index for black, the new condition is false and no color escape is emitted. The text retains the terminal's existing color instead of using the requested black.

findings.description: Removing color component validation allows invalid palette indices and RGB components to produce invalid ANSI sequences.
findings.rationale: For example, style('text', fg=256) or style('text', fg=(256, 0, 0)) previously raised ValueError. These inputs now generate escape sequences with out-of-range color values, silently passing malformed styling to the terminal instead of rejecting the invalid color.
